connectors.name: TrustTech ID Connector
connectors.description: ID verifier that lets organisations accept certified EUDI Wallets, business wallets, eIDs, bank logins and document reads through one OpenID Connect integration. Returns a normalised result with an assurance level, handles relying-party registration, access certificates, wallet unit attestation checks and revocation checks, and runs as a managed service, in a private cloud or on-premise. The package is containerised and can use an HSM or keystore. EUDI Wallet verification uses OpenID4VP and DCQL, with SD-JWT VC and ISO mdoc under the HAIP profile.
